title: Day view
description: Who works where, their time off and every appointment. Click free time to book, drag an appointment to move it.

help.title: About the day view
help.overview: The clinic's day on one screen: a column for each dentist at each location, with their working hours, time off and appointments.

sections.title: On this page
items: Pick a location or all of them, and move between days with the arrows, the date or Today.
Click an appointment to open it. Click free working time to book an appointment there.
Appointments wear the color of their status, time off is grayed out, and a red line marks the current time today. Each location shows its own time zone.
A dentist with a linked login sees only their own appointments.

sections.title: Moving an appointment
items: Drag an appointment that is awaiting confirmation or confirmed to another time, or to another dentist at the same location.

Where it would land turns green when it fits, or red with the reason when it doesn't: outside working hours, time off, another appointment, a time that has passed, or a treatment that dentist doesn't do.
The move is checked like a new booking, so the clinic's booking rules still apply.
